original_visual_gates.field_boolean_semantics: The unmodified upstream gate builder sets all visual booleans false when its pixel diff fails. These are not independent findings of content loss or clipping.

original_structure_cli.scope: Structural CLI without full original manifest policy validation; this is not the full original production gate.

editability.tables_implementation: editable text boxes and rules; not native table objects
editability.counting_rule: Text shapes have at least one nonempty a:t run. Other native shapes exclude those text shapes. Total is 154, not 90 + 154.

visual_review.method: Author viewed every single-page PowerPoint PNG and all merged full-page renders. Text wrapping on slides 2 and 5 was corrected. Original image comparison failures are retained separately.
visual_review.result: No clipping or semantic omissions observed in final pages. Small footnotes are for self-reading. Original blueprint fonts and icons differ from native reconstruction; strict 1:1 gate not passed.

limitations: Original strict 1:1 fidelity gate not passed; this is a Japanese derivative example.
Agent review only; no independent or human adoption review is claimed.
Dates, venues, fees and operating plan are fictional; no real-world effects measured.
New rebuilt artifacts need another full visual review.

numeric_fidelity_interpretation.what_failed: Pixel position, width and height alignment of rendered glyph/shape ink versus generated bitmap blueprint. This does not mean event dates, times, fees or the two-week proposal changed.
numeric_fidelity_interpretation.normalization: Whitespace/newlines only; Japanese wording, dates, times, fees and punctuation remain required.
numeric_fidelity_interpretation.cause: Different generated glyphs/icon geometry and native font metrics, plus limited threshold-based local ink measurement. No OCR was used to infer content values.
